environment_notes: The system python3 initially lacked pytest, causing the first pytest baseline command to fail before test collection.
A temporary venv was created at /private/tmp/valkey-scale-lab-l00-venv and populated with requirements-dev.txt plus an editable project install.
The pytest baseline commands were rerun with python3 resolved from the temporary venv via PATH prefix.

commands.name: runtime_fault_failover_orchestrator
commands.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/integration tests/fault tests/failover tests/orchestrator

commands.name: analysis_report_stability_scale
commands.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/analysis tests/report tests/stability tests/scale
